text:
alex.dev: Heads up — prod embeddings latency spike correlated with a new model shard allocation at 22:02. Seeing elevated p95 and OOM traces in eu-west1.
priya-sre: I see it in the grafana alerts. Memory climb on embed-service-v2 right after last deploy. Paging oncall.
pager: @priya-sre oncall triggered — investigating.
ben-release: We have a patch ready that reverts the allocation change and pins the runtime image to rrdw-inference:2026-03-18-hotfix. It's a one-line kube image update + config bump.
emily-pm: Customer-impacting? Any risk to ongoing jobs?
alex.dev: Some small batch jobs are failing intermittently, real-time requests degraded. Impact limited but growing.
priya-sre: Recommend expedited hotfix deploy to prod eu-west1 only. Canary won't help since traffic is already mostly in that region. Need approvals: SRE lead, Release owner, and PM.
ben-release: Deploy bot ready. Command to run: 
```
/deploy embed-service --image rrdw-inference:2026-03-18-hotfix --region eu-west1 --tag hotfix-5943
```
deploy-bot: deploy request queued. Requires explicit approvals from @priya-sre and @emily-pm to proceed. Rollback policy: automatic rollback on >2% error spike within 5m, manual rollback allowed.
priya-sre: Approving from SRE side. :thumbsup:
emily-pm: Approving from PM — prioritize stability. Please include a blurb in release notes linking to incident and rollback criteria.
alex.dev: Ben, please include release note: "hotfix: pin runtime image to avoid memory regression; region: eu-west1; rollback on error spike." Add K8s diff in PR.
ben-release: Pushing PR and kicking deploy. PR: https://deploy.internal/pr/1129 — includes kubectl patch.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout hotfix-5943 -> embed-service (eu-west1). Progress: 0/6 pods updated. Live logs: https://logs.internal/5943212345
priya-sre: Monitoring logs and metrics. If error rate >2% rollback automatically. Watching KV cache warming.
ben-release: Rollout at 4/6, latency normalizing.
alex.dev: If we see flaps after 6/6, be ready to trigger manual rollback and re-pin to previous image tag rrdw-inference:2026-03-10-stable.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 6/6 pods updated. No rollback triggered.
emily-pm: Thanks team. Please update release-notes/postmortem later with root cause and customer note.
priya-sre: Closing expedited hotfix ticket and marking postmortem required.
ben-release: Noted — will open follow-up issue to improve shard allocation test coverage.
alex.dev: :rocket: Good catch everyone.
